arguments.prompt:
Create one small straight-on dark wood shield plaque, gold rim and one top nail, with a distinctive grey stone shoulder-armor trophy token with a little rot-green moss mounted on its face. Clean readable icon at 32x32; plaque visible at most 30x30.

Use deliberate pixel-art clusters with a colored outline, clean pixel edges and only 2-3 readable material planes. Isolated transparent-background game sprite, one fixed complete object, centered on its native pivot, no scene, shadow, glow, gradient, blur, anti-aliased halo, text, labels, numbers, watermark, frame, panel, or contact sheet. Final native target is 48x64 (pivot 24,32) for the cover; 16x16 (pivot 8,8) for a tab; 32x32 (pivot 16,16) for a trophy; 24x24 (pivot 12,12) for a medal; 64x12 (pivot 32,6) for the divider. Preserve generous transparent margins and keep all artwork comfortably inside the stated visible bounds.
